high_level_description: The image depicts a vibrant and colorful painted tile or decorative panel. The background of the tile is a solid bright red color, which serves as a striking contrast to the other elements on it. The design features a central large yellow flower with a blue center and numerous thin, radiating lines that resemble petals. Surrounding this central flower are several smaller blue flowers with yellow centers, each having five petals. The leaves and stems of the flowers are green, with some leaves having a slightly wavy edge.
